text:
Alex: kicking off prep for the v2 incremental flip this Thursday 02:00-04:00 UTC. planning to do tenant-stripe-by-stripe with a 10m warmup per stripe. ops handoff at 01:45 UTC.
Maya: noted. can we add a probe-sample-rate bump for the first 30m? want more telemetry on 5xx/latency.
Jordan: agree on extra probes. also pushing a small deploybot tweak to avoid double-canary for streaming routes. will patch before the window.
Pat: FYI mobile SDK still has that header-case mismatch for chunked streams — is it pinned in the canary list?
Taylor: mobile is on the exclude list for stripe-3. we should keep it excluded until Pat's patch lands and we confirm client update.
DeployBot: scheduled rollout created by @Jordan for 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z. canary: stripe-1 (5%), ramp plan: 5->25->50->100 over 90m, health checks: 200s, 4xx/5xx thresholds.
Erin: release notes draft pushed to /docs/notes/v2-rollout.md — added migration hints and pin instructions for SDKs. please proofread.
Sam: ops checklist: smoke tests, synthetic traffic, token-rate heatmap, and a rollback playbook doc. i can own rollback exec if needed.
Alex: rollback triggers proposed: sustained 5xx > 1.5% for 10m, p50 latency > 250ms delta vs baseline for 5m, or client-signaled pin hits > 20 tenants in 15m. sound reasonable?
Maya: add a slow-streaming spike trigger too — if streaming success rate drops > 3% and tail-latency spikes, we should pause.
Jordan: deploybot patch done: avoids automatic ramp if probe gap > 30s. also added an operator flag to force-hold canary.
Pat: patch for header-case is in PR #4210. requesting a quick canary of stripe-1 after warmup to validate mobile headers.
Taylor: let's not flip mobile until PR merged and mobile SDK release is out. risk too high for chunked clients.
Alex: plan: stripe-1: non-mobile tenants + post-merge pat-canary. stripe-2: ramp if stripe-1 green. stripe-3: include mobile only after SDK release and 24h green on non-mobile.
DeployBot: deploy started for stripe-1 at 5864123460 by Jordan. canary id cb-5864-01. healthchecks running.
Maya: seeing 2x small latency bump in one probe region (iad). holding until we confirm it's transient. Sam pls run synthetic there.
Sam: running synthetic now, spike looks tied to one edge node. redirecting traffic for probes, continuing monitoring.
Alex: timeline check — if stripe-1 stays green for 45m we follow normal ramp. otherwise we pause, root cause, and either hotfix or rollback. ops, stand by. :eyes:
